_about: Public-domain George Salmon (1819-1904, Provost of Trinity College, Dublin) for the Word Hoard: 9 books from Internet Archive scans, 1861-1907: Sermons Preached in Trinity College (1861), The Reign of Law (1873), Non-Miraculous Christianity (1881), A Historical Introduction to the Study of the Books of the New Testament (first edition, 1885), Gnosticism and Agnosticism (1887), The Infallibility of the Church (first edition, 1888), Some Thoughts on the Textual Criticism of the New Testament (1897), Cathedral and University Sermons (1900) and the posthumous Episcopacy and Other Sermons (1907). Raw OCR. His mathematics is left out. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
